hardware: Apple M2 Max, 64 GiB unified memory, one host

provenance.hash_scope: UTF-8 canonical compact JSON with sorted keys over scope, prime_limit, primes, orders_by_prime, iterations_by_prime.

author_generator.schedule: Consecutive odd q, M_q=(1<<q)-1, preserved including composite q.
author_generator.normalization: Exact author Crystal primes-utils unavailable; all finite final paths share GMP probable-prime(25). Floating-log reporting and console output excluded.
author_generator.source_record: results/jabari_comparison.json author_sources identifies the inspected forum snapshot and PDF.

limitations: Small-factor screening and shared GMP probable-prime classification, not primality certification or a GIMPS comparison.
Full variants time plan preparation; prepared variants reuse one plan. All GPU calls include allocation, transfer, dispatch, synchronization, readback and result mapping.
GPU initialization/kernel compilation, equality checks and output excluded; first-call costs separately recorded.
One M2 Max with uncontrolled background load and temperature; medians and raw repeats are exploratory measurements.
Tile selection is a measured tuning probe, not an automatic CPU/GPU policy or a universal optimum.
Billion-exponent stream executes filtering only; growing M_q BigInts and GMP tests make a full-search linear extrapolation invalid.

final_cases.scope: Identical finite M_q inputs and shared GMP(25); author's unpublished primes-utils unavailable. Full variants include plan preparation; prepared variants reuse one plan. Both include allocation, transfer, dispatch, readback and survivor GMP tests. GPU initialization/compilation, equality checks and output excluded. Legacy methods include 32-entry compatible-k rebasing.
